page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Below the text, a centred heading "LOCVS IX." with a subtitle "De angelis.", followed by numbered theses. Line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) stand in the right margin.

p.i: contra te malum è domo tuâ: & accipiens vxores tuas ante oculos tuos tradam proximo tuo: qui cubabit cum vxoribus suis coram isto sole. Quia tu fecisti clam, etiam ego facturus sum rem hanc coram toto Israële, & coram sole.

main_text.p: 2.Sam.16.v.10.11. Si Iehoua dixit ei (Simei) Maledic Dauidi: ecquis dicat, Quare sic facis? Sinite eum vt maledicat: quia edixit ei Iehoua.5

1.Reg.22.v.21.22. Prodijt quidam spiritus, qui consistens coram Domino, dixit: Ego pelliciam eum. (Achabum) Dicente vero Domino, quo pacto? Dixit: Egressus ero spiritus mendacij in ore10 omnium prophetarum eius. Tunc dixit, Pellicies etiamq; praualebis: exi, & fac ita.

Esa.10. verf.5.& deinceps. Va Assyrio (Sanheribo) virga iræ meæ: quamuis in manu baculus est indignationis meæ: In gentem hypocritam immittam ipsum, & contra populum, in quem ex-15 candui, dabo mandata ipsi; vt prædetur prædam, & vt diripiat rapinam, &c.
Actor.2.v.23. Hunc (Iesum) definito consilio & antedecreto Dei deditum cum accepisfetis, manibus sceleratorum affixum interemistis.20

Et cap.4.verf.27.28. Congregati vero sunt contra sanctum puerum tuum Iesum, quem vnxisti. Herodes & Pontius Pilatus, cum gentibus & populis Israël, vt facerent quæcunque manus tua & consilium tuum prius definierat, vt fierent.25
main_text.head: LOCVS IX.
De angelis.
main_text.p: 1. Angeli sunt spiritus meri, hoc est, à corpo-30re liberi.
Hebr.i.v.14. Nonne omnes (angeli boni) sunt ministratores Spiritus?
Matth.10. verf.1. Dedit eis potestatem aduersus spiritus immundos.35
Luc.24.v.39. Spiritus carnem & ossa non habet.

page.notes: Line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin are printed. The short stroke at the left margin near the middle of the page, and the dark spots and stains, are not printed text and are left out. The superscript 3 after "etiamq;" in the line "Pellicies etiamq; praualebis" is doubtful and may belong to the word or be a stray mark; it is not transcribed. Long s is written as plain s throughout; the printed f-like forms in "interemiftis", "fanctum" and "fecifti" are read as s. The "Ifraële" accent is copied as "Israële". The word "Ange-" at the foot is a hyphenated line-end word starting the following paragraph and is set as a paragraph.
